🎥🎬: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts (2023)

In 1994, ex-military electronics expert Noah Diaz and artifact researcher Elena Wallace become caught in a battle between the Autobots and the Terrorcons, who are searching for a powerful ancient artifact. Noah soon teams up with Optimus Prime and the Autobots as a much bigger threat emerges.

The heroes discover that the artifact is connected to the Maximals, a group of Transformers who have been hiding on Earth. With the Terrorcons closing in and the fate of the planet at stake, humans, Autobots, and Maximals must join forces for an epic final battle.

source_details.title: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
source_details.synopsis: Transformers: Rise of the Beasts is a 2023 American science fiction action film based on Hasbro's Transformers toy line, and primarily influenced by its Beast Wars sub-franchise. It is the seventh installment in the Transformers film series, and a sequel to Bumblebee (2018). The film was directed by Steven Caple Jr. and written by Joby Harold, Darnell Metayer, Josh Peters, Erich Hoeber, and Jon Hoeber, and stars Anthony Ramos and Dominique Fishback, alongside the voices of Ron Perlman, Peter Dinklage, Michelle Yeoh, Pete Davidson, Liza Koshy, Michaela Jaé Rodriguez, Colman Domingo, Cristo Fernández, Tongayi Chirisa, and returning franchise regulars Peter Cullen, John DiMaggio, and David Sobo
